steps.title: Prepare Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Prepare a 5x10^7 human cell pellet (fresh or stored at -80°C) in a 50 ml Falcon tube. For E. coli, use an overnight culture in 50 ml LB broth spun down at 4500 x g for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet by pipette mixing in 200 µl sterile 1X PBS (Phosphate-buffered saline).

steps.title: Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Add 10 ml TLB to the cells and vortex at full speed for 5 seconds to achieve a homogenous solution.

steps.title: Incubate for Lysis
steps.instruction: Incubate the solution at 37°C for 1 hour until the solution turns transparent.

steps.title: Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl Qiagen Proteinase K (Catalog #19131) or other stock solution to a final concentration of 200 µg/ml.

substeps.instruction: Mix by slowly rotating end-over-end 3 times.
Incubate at 50°C for 2 hours, mixing every 30 minutes by slowly rotating end-over-end 3 times.

steps.title: First Phenol Extraction
steps.instruction: Split the viscous lysate into two 15 ml Falcon tubes prepared with phase-lock gel using a 10 ml serological pipette at slow speed.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 ml recently opened BioUltra TE-saturated phenol (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #77607) to each tube.
Place on a HulaMixer at 20 rpm for 10 minutes (increase speed gradually if a fine emulsion does not form after one minute).
Centrifuge at 4500 rpm for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Second Phenol Extraction
steps.instruction: Pour the aqueous phases into two new 15 ml Falcon tubes containing phase-lock gel, avoiding the protein layer.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 ml buffer saturated phenol (BioUltra TE-saturated phenol) and 2.5 ml chloroform-isoamyl alcohol 24:1 (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #25666) to each tube.
Place on a HulaMixer at 20 rpm for 10 minutes (increase speed gradually if a fine emulsion does not form after one minute).
Centrifuge at 4500 rpm for 10 minutes.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Combine the aqueous phases from the two tubes by pouring slowly into a new 50 ml Falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 ml 5 M ammonium acetate (G-Biosciences Catalog #R012).
Add 30 ml ice-cold absolute ethanol (Merck Millipore Catalog #107017) and observe DNA precipitation.

steps.title: DNA Recovery
steps.instruction: Recover the DNA precipitate using a glass capillary hook (made by melting the tip in a blue flame).

substeps.instruction: Hook out the DNA in one piece, lifting it to allow excess liquid to drip off.
Submerge the DNA in a 50 ml Falcon tube containing 70% ethanol until it forms a whitish opaque pellet.
Carefully work the pellet off the glass rod using the rim of an Eppendorf tube and drop it into the tube.
Repeat for any remaining DNA fragments.

steps.title: DNA Washing and Drying
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 ml 70% ethanol to the Eppendorf tube.
Spin down at 10,000 x g and remove as much 70% ethanol as possible.
Wash again with 1 ml 70% ethanol.
Spin down at 10,000 x g and remove as much 70% ethanol as possible.
Allow remaining ethanol to evaporate by leaving at room temperature (RT) for 15 minutes.

steps.title: DNA Resuspension
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl EB + Triton-X100 (final Triton-X100 concentration 0.02%) and incubate without mixing at 5°C for 2 days until the pellet resuspends into a translucent viscous gel.

steps.title: DNA Quantification and Adjustment
steps.instruction: Quantify and adjust the DNA concentration.

substeps.instruction: Use a P2 pipette with a cut-off tip to aspirate DNA very slowly, pulling and releasing to work the DNA away from the tube; determine the volume removed by adjusting the pipette volume.
Quantify using Qubit BR assay (target concentration >1 µg/µl).
Check the absorbance spectrum of a 1:10 dilution on a NanoDrop.
If necessary, add more EB+Triton-X100 to adjust concentration to 1 µg/ul without mixing.

steps.title: Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA library for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Slowly pipette 16 µl DNA into a 0.2 ml PCR tube using a cut-off P20 pipette tip; retain the tip.
Remove 1 µl from the tube and quantify using Qubit BR assay to verify input.
Add 1.5 µl FRA and 3.5 µl EB+Triton-X100. Using a P20 set to 18 µl and the original tip, mix up and down as slowly as possible 8 times; retain the tip.
Add 1 µl RAP. Using a P20 set to 19 µl and the original tip, mix up and down as slowly as possible 8 times; discard tip.
Incubate at room temperature while priming the flowcell.
Add 30 µl FLT to a tube of FLB, vortex briefly, and spin down to create flush mix.
Place new flowcell on MinION and run platform QC.
Remove a small amount of storage buffer from the inlet port using a P1000 and the volume adjustment screw.
Load 800 µl flush mix via the inlet port slowly using the plunger; wait 5 minutes.
Lift the SpotON port cover and load 200 µl flush mix via the inlet port slowly, ensuring a bead of liquid is visible over the SpotON port before being siphoned back in.

steps.title: Library Loading
steps.instruction: Load the prepared library onto the flowcell.

substeps.instruction: Add 34 µl SQT and 20 µl NFW to the library tube (do not use loading beads).
Using a P100 set to 75 µl with a cut-off tip, mix up and down as slowly as possible 5 times.
Slowly pipette the diluted library onto the SpotON port as it is siphoned in. If blocked, load by holding the pipette vertically against the SpotON port and positively pipetting directly in.
